result.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
result.summary: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. To balance efficiency and quality, we introduce U-shaped MoLT (U-MoLT), which separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points. In 100B-token continued pretraining of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, our U-MoLT adaptation lowers CE on all 11 domains over the matched baseline with 1.4x mean token efficiency. At inference, U-MoLT with MoL-Hybrid-2 matches non-looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 vs. 1,000.6 ms on S-size (~113M) models. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Mixture-of-Loops Transformer，用 KV 作为跨深度与循环选择性复用的记忆，并给出保留残差流的 MoLT-R、从 embedding 重启并读取前序循环记忆的 MoLT-KV、配 loop forcing 的并行训练与可跳过无用解码遍历的 U 形结构，在 400B/100B token 预训练中验证效率与质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 「循环间传递什么」的状态设计、单遍解码超出训练循环长度以及按需跳过遍历，可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 的循环 latent 状态更新、动态计算与循环深度泛化，但该工作为纯文本架构，视觉证据条件下的有效性未知。
